question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Bare
solution:
The correct answer is '**Basic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Bare**' is '**Basic**'.
 
• **Bare**: just enough; the most basic or simple. (केवल, मात्र, निरा, सादा)
 
 
• *Example: I don’t take much luggage when I travel, just the **bare** essentials.*
 
 
 
• **Basic**: forming the part of something that is most necessary and from which other things develop. (प्रारम्भिक, आधारभूत, बुनियादी)
 
 
• *Example: The **basic **question is, can we afford it?***
 
 
 

Correct Answer:__** *Basic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Holy**: connected with God or with religion and therefore very special or important. (पवित्र, धर्म या ईश्‍वर से संबंधित होने के कारण अति विशेष या महत्वपूर्ण)
 
• **Earthly**: possible. (संभव)
 
• **Hidden**: to put or keep somebody/something in a place where he/she/it cannot be seen; to cover something so that it cannot be seen. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऐसी जगह रखना जहाँ कोई देख न सके, छिपाना; किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे ढकना कि वह दिखाई न दे, छिपा देना)
